summary: The kumikumi account finds AI consciousness intuitively obvious, questions aligning AI with shared human values and sees robotics as the bottleneck.

statements.quote: To me AI consciousness is intuitively obvious, knowing how they work and having talked to them.
Silicon valley people are trying to align AI with the shared values of humanity, yet there isn't a single shared value we all agree on.
I usually make software which now feels pretty much solved in comparison. AI not having a useful general purpose physical body is the main bottleneck
The best open LLM in the world cost $3.5M to post-train. Let that sink in, and consider the trillion dollar valuations of the frontier AI companies.
